name: Campbell's Condensed Chicken Noodle Soup
whyItWorks: A classic pantry lifesaver. Made with savory chicken broth, enriched egg noodles, and lean chicken meat with under 1g fiber. Diluting the condensed can with water creates a soothing, hydrating meal that is easy on inflamed intestines.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Mix 1 can of soup with 1 can of warm water on the stovetop. Heat until simmering and let cool slightly before eating.
